name: bmo-dxy-decomposition
description: BMO reproduction: Weekly geometric decomposition of DXY contributions by currency (EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, SEK, CHF). Stacked bars show each currency's weighted contribution to DXY weekly return, with DXY total as line overlay.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BMO REPRODUCTION: DXY GEOMETRIC DECOMPOSITION
# =============================================================================
# Weekly decomposition of DXY returns into currency contributions.
# DXY = geometric weighted index of 6 currencies.
# Contribution = weight * log_return(FX pair), sign-adjusted.
#
# DXY weights: EUR 57.6%, JPY 13.6%, GBP 11.9%, CAD 9.1%, SEK 4.2%, CHF 3.6%
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
idx = index()()

# --- Week-Year label for x-axis aggregation ---
wk = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.week)(idx)
yr = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(idx)
wk_label = yr * 100 + wk

# =============================================================================
# FX DATA: fetch close prices for all 6 DXY components
# =============================================================================

eur_src = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.EURUSD)()
jpy_src = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.USDJPY)()
gbp_src = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.GBPUSD)()
cad_src = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.USDCAD)()
chf_src = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.USDCHF)()
sek_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDSEK')()

# =============================================================================
# DAILY LOG RETURNS
# =============================================================================

eur_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(eur_src.c)
jpy_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(jpy_src.c)
gbp_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(gbp_src.c)
cad_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(cad_src.c)
chf_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(chf_src.c)
sek_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(sek_src.c)

# =============================================================================
# DXY WEIGHTED CONTRIBUTIONS (daily, in percentage points)
# Sign convention: DXY up = USD stronger
#   EURUSD down = USD stronger → multiply by -1
#   USDJPY up   = USD stronger → multiply by +1
#   GBPUSD down = USD stronger → multiply by -1
#   USDCAD up   = USD stronger → multiply by +1
#   USDCHF up   = USD stronger → multiply by +1
#   USDSEK up   = USD stronger → multiply by +1
# Multiply by 100 to get percentage points
# =============================================================================

eur_contrib = -0.576 * eur_ret * 100
jpy_contrib =  0.136 * jpy_ret * 100
gbp_contrib = -0.119 * gbp_ret * 100
cad_contrib =  0.091 * cad_ret * 100
chf_contrib =  0.036 * chf_ret * 100
sek_contrib =  0.042 * sek_ret * 100

# DXY total (sum of all contributions)
dxy_total = eur_contrib + jpy_contrib + gbp_contrib + cad_contrib + chf_contrib + sek_contrib

# =============================================================================
# STACKED BAR CHART: Weekly DXY Decomposition
# xy_bars with agg=Sum aggregates daily contributions within each week
# overlay_series adds the DXY total line
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='The USD Stages a Comeback in Late Q1',
    category='DXY Decomposition',
    x_axis_label='',
    y_axis_label='Weekly Contribution (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.WeekYear,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    data_labels=False,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='EUR', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='JPY', color=Color.Yellow),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='GBP', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CAD', color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='SEK', color=Color.Purple),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CHF', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DXY', color=Color.Black)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(eur_contrib, jpy_contrib, gbp_contrib, cad_contrib, sek_contrib, chf_contrib, label=wk_label, overlays=dxy_total)
